reviews.name: Victoria
reviews.text: I’ve been working through the AI training course for a couple of months now and it’s been really helpful! My client is happy with the increased productivity and they enjoy reading through the monthly progress report they receive. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Mary Jean Gregorio
reviews.text: The AI training was both practical and insightful, and its applications were immediately useful. I learned how to utilize AI tools more effectively to enhance workflows, save time, and develop more efficient processes, while also understanding the importance of responsible AI use. The training provided practical skills that I could apply straight away in my role and has changed the way I approach everyday tasks.

reviews.name: Emelita Jadraque
reviews.text: I’ve been part of the Ad On AI training academy for a while now and it’s genuinely helped me grow. The sessions are practical, not just theory, so I’ve been able to apply what I learn straight away. Beyond what’s covered in the program, it’s given me the confidence to keep exploring AI tools on my own to work smarter and get more done day-to-day. Would recommend it to anyone wanting to build real, usable AI skills rather than just ticking a box.

reviews.text: I highly recommend Ad On Group to create your website and manage your digital marketing. Their creative team is highly skilled in designing and writing informative blogs and digital brochures, and adept in SEO strategies that have consistently driven traffic and sales. Their cutting-edge approach lets us focus on our business goals.

reviews.text: Thank you Charlotte, I am extremely happy with the adjustments and your work. It looks fantastic.
